MEET THE ARTIST / 윤미래

Yoon Mirae

Also known as Tasha or T, Yoon Mirae is a rapper and singer whose work spans hip-hop, R&B and drama soundtracks. She debuted with Uptown in 1997, performed in the duo Tashannie, and began her solo career with As Time Goes By in 2001.

Her 2007 album t 3 YOONMIRAE won Best R&B & Soul Album at the 2008 Korean Music Awards. “What’s Up! Mr. Good Stuff” won Best R&B & Soul Song that year. Her catalogue connects personal rap songs, soul singing and widely heard drama soundtracks.

R&B / HIP-HOP / 2025

Guitar-led and spare, “Breath” leaves room for Yoon Mirae’s voice. This acoustic R&B song follows the small, ordinary reminders that remain after a breakup.

Composed by Yoon Mirae & Tiger JK. Lyrics by Tiger JK.
